resources.string: Location is being monitored while tracking is on
Location permission is required for tracking. Please grant it.
Linked as %1$s… — fixes stream to your dashboard
Not linked — enter a pairing code from the dashboard
Enter the server URL and pairing code first.
Pairing failed — check the code and that the server is running.
Offline vault: %1$d pending (%2$d evidence) — auto-syncs the moment this phone touches any network (Wi-Fi or new SIM data)
Offline vault: empty — captured evidence is stored locally even without data and uploaded when the phone reconnects

This device is reported lost in the Dravex network. Enter the recovery code that was set when it was reported to unlock the app. If this is not your device, please return it to the nearest police station.
Unlocked — you can now use the app. Mark the device found in your dashboard to fully disarm it.
Bought this phone used, or checking a second-hand buy? Dial *#06# to see the IMEI and check it against the stolen-device registry before trusting it.
Enter at least 6 digits of the IMEI first.
STOLEN — this IMEI is listed in the Dravex stolen-device registry. Do not use it; report it to the nearest police station.
Clean — no active stolen report for this IMEI.
Registry unreachable — check your server URL and internet connection.

Phone makers (Samsung, Tecno, Infinix…) often kill background apps to save battery — that would silence Dravex exactly when a thief powers the phone on. Allow Dravex to ignore battery optimization so tracking, the beacon and evidence capture keep running.

This device is reported lost. If you found it, send the owner one short message — it is delivered anonymously and the owner is notified immediately. The device stays locked until the owner unlocks it.
e.g. "I found this phone at Ikeja bus stop. Call 0803…"
Message sent to the owner. This device remains locked and protected.
